Main.title: All-in-One CRM for <highlight>Travel Agencies</highlight>
Main.description: Manage visas, bookings, transfers, and client services in one powerful travel management platform. Hebent Travel Tech CRM helps travel agencies automate workflows and deliver seamless travel experiences.
Main.servicesDescription: Five core modules designed to cover every aspect of your travel business — from client management to bookings and reporting.

Services.label: Our Services
Services.title: Everything Your Agency Needs
Services.description: Five core modules designed to cover every aspect of travel operations.

visa.title: Visa Assistance
visa.description: Simplify visa processing with structured workflows, document tracking, and request management for faster application handling.

translation.title: Translation Services
translation.description: Manage document translations for visas and travel documents with organized requests and easy communication.

hotel.title: Hotel Booking
hotel.description: Handle hotel reservations efficiently and keep track of client bookings in one centralized platform.

ticket.title: Ticket Management
ticket.description: Organize flight tickets and travel itineraries while maintaining clear records for every client.

transfer.title: Transfer Services
transfer.description: Coordinate airport pickups, local transfers, and transportation services for your travelers.

automation.title: Automation of Travel Operations
automation.description: Eliminate manual data entry with smart automation that handles visa workflows, booking confirmations, and client notifications.

clients.title: Centralized Client Management
clients.description: One unified profile per client with complete travel history, document archives, and communication logs.

booking.title: Faster Booking Workflows
booking.description: Streamlined processes from inquiry to confirmation. Multi-supplier bookings in a single workflow.

tracking.title: Real-Time Tracking
tracking.description: Live status updates for visa applications, flight schedules, hotel confirmations, and transfer dispatches.

secure.title: Secure Cloud-based CRM
secure.description: Enterprise-grade security with daily backups, role-based access, and compliance with international data protection standards.

builtForTravel.title: Built for Travel Businesses
builtForTravel.description: Purpose-built for agencies, not a generic CRM retrofitted for travel. Every feature speaks your language.

integrations.title: Easy Integrations
integrations.description: Connect with GDS systems, payment gateways, embassy APIs, and communication tools out of the box.

scalable.title: Scalable SaaS Solution
scalable.description: From solo travel consultants to 500-agent enterprises. The platform scales with your growth.

support.title: Fast Customer Support
support.description: Dedicated support team with travel industry expertise. Average response time under 4 hours.

Cta.title: Ready to modernize your travel operations?
Cta.description: Join thousands of agencies already using Hebent Travel Tech to streamline their workflows. Start with a free trial — no credit card required.

Solution.title: All solutions on one platform
Solution.subtitle: We are proud that our platform is easy to use and helps you solve tasks faster. Setup and launch in 3 simple steps.

install.title: Install GPS trackers
install.description: We provide compact GPS devices that are easily installed in any vehicle in your fleet.

connect.title: Connect to the platform
connect.description: Vehicles connect to the platform automatically. See them appear on your dashboard instantly.

monitor.title: Monitor and mobile
monitor.description: Track, analyze, and optimize your entire fleet from one powerful online platform.

Footer.tagline: The all-in-one CRM platform built for modern travel agencies and tour operators.

items1.description: We may collect data about how you interact with our website, including IP address, browser type, pages visited, time spent on pages, and referring websites.
